tests.scope: Offline tests; clean Git identity is mocked in materialization tests. Actual archived Python replay executes in full-release and replay-kit tests.

findings: Release planning independently requires CURRENT_CLEAN and audited selected files even without SOURCE_FRESH in the dossier profile. Coverage unconditionally includes canonical sources.

Replay lane command equality, declared resource/receipt roles and hashes are checked. Neither planner nor materializer executes replay commands; NOT_APPLICABLE bypasses load-bearing replay debt by explicit policy. This is packaging, not mathematical admission.
Generated artifacts can remove only ARTIFACTS_PRESENT blockers for missing PUBLICATION placeholders with matching generator contracts. They do not prove claims or discharge replay criteria.
Replay kit intentionally ignores profile/publication-only coverage blockers, but retains selected payload and resource custody checks.
Publication retains declared grades/scopes; release_covered means selected evidence, not proven or even independently executed evidence. Output includes editorial authority boundaries.

Materializer takes an evaluated mutable dict, checks its readiness flag and source bytes/commit/dirt, but does not recompute its plan fingerprint or re-run full normalization. CLI builds the plan immediately; arbitrary direct API plans require a separate trust-boundary assessment.

Source hashes are checked before copyfile; output is not rehashed after copying. Atomic directory rename is not a source snapshot guarantee. Concurrent source modification and hostile-plan controls remain untested.
Publication uses shallow references for nested metadata; stored fingerprints are not continuously refreshed following caller mutation.
Synthetic verifier is intentionally relocated into archive/replay with sibling authority and receipts. Archived replay passes: prior source-directory failure is not an established packaging defect.

Six synthetic controls verify a copy-time source change yields an archive digest mismatch, mutable direct-API plan licensing is not rechecked, ordinary writer refusals work, preexisting PID temporary files are deleted on exclusive-open failure, and case-alias protected paths overwrite on Windows. See exact scope qualifications in boundary audit.
remaining: Broader path/resource and concurrency controls remain; these bounded controls do not exhaust materializer semantics.
Historical campaign paragraphs are retained claims, not independently verified live campaign evidence.
